project.name: ferdium
project.description: Ferdium is a desktop app that aggregates messaging services into a single window — a hard-fork of Franz built with Electron, React, MobX, TypeScript, and an embedded AdonisJS internal server.

nodes.name: App Locales Registry
nodes.summary: Defines APP_LOCALES mapping locale codes to human-readable names, and SPELLCHECKER_LOCALES for Hunspell-compatible spellcheck languages. Used by translations.ts to enumerate which locale files to load.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports two const objects: APP_LOCALES (58 locales) and SPELLCHECKER_LOCALES (45 locales with region-specific variants).

nodes.name: Translation Loader
nodes.summary: Dynamically loads all locale JSON files at runtime. Iterates over APP_LOCALES keys and require()s the corresponding ./locales/{key}.json file.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dynamic require() with try/catch to gracefully skip missing locale files. Exports generatedTranslations() function.

nodes.name: generatedTranslations
nodes.summary: Default export function that iterates all APP_LOCALES keys and dynamically requires the matching JSON locale file. Returns an array of translation objects keyed by locale code.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses import/no-dynamic-require pattern with eslint-disable. Warns to console if a locale file is missing.

nodes.name: Ferdium Internationalization System
nodes.summary: The internationalization system for Ferdium. Uses flat JSON locale files loaded dynamically at runtime via translations.ts, with locale codes registered in languages.ts. Translations are community-managed via Crowdin.
nodes.languageNotes: 58 locale codes registered, ~25 fully populated JSON files in this batch. Strings use dot-notation keys like 'settings.app.form.language'.

nodes.name: AppLoader/index.tsx
nodes.summary: Startup loading screen component that cycles through humorous rotating slogans using a timed interval. Displays FullscreenLoader with shuffled messages from react-intl definitions. Uses CSS transitions via JSS and integrates with theme for spinner color.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with MobX observer, JSS styling, react-intl i18n

nodes.name: AppLoader/styles.ts
nodes.summary: JSS style definitions for AppLoader component. Defines component, slogan, and visible style classes with respect for prefers-reduced-motion media query for accessibility.
nodes.languageNotes: JSS style object with CSS-in-JS, respects prefers-reduced-motion

nodes.name: FAB.tsx
nodes.summary: Floating Action Button component. A MobX-observed button wrapper with disabled state, optional onClick, type, and htmlForm support. Used for prominent action triggers in the UI.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with @observer decorator

nodes.name: FullscreenLoader/index.tsx
nodes.summary: Fullscreen loading overlay component with centered layout, title, spinner, and optional children content. Used as a wrapper by AppLoader and WebviewLoader for consistent loading UI across the application.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with @observer, JSS styling

nodes.name: FullscreenLoader/styles.ts
nodes.summary: JSS style definitions for FullscreenLoader. Provides flexbox-centered fullscreen layout with title, content spacing, and 8px gap system.
nodes.languageNotes: JSS style object with flexbox layout

nodes.name: InfoBar.tsx
nodes.summary: Info bar notification component that slides in from top or bottom. Supports CTA button with loading state, non-sticky dismissible close button, and type-based theming. Uses Appear animation wrapper and Icon/Loader sub-components.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with @observer, react-intl i18n, @mdi/js icons

nodes.name: Infobox.tsx
nodes.summary: Infobox notification component with icon support, CTA button with loader, dismissible option, and type-based theming. Calls onSeen callback on mount and supports dismissed state tracking. Uses @mdi/js icon set.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with @observer, react-intl i18n, @mdi/js icons

nodes.name: Link.tsx
nodes.summary: Internal application link component supporting both internal routing (via MobX router) and external URL opening. Handles disabled state, active class matching via route patterns, and blank target navigation through openExternalUrl.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with @inject('stores') and @observer, MobX routing integration

nodes.name: Modal/index.tsx
nodes.summary: Modal dialog component wrapping react-modal. Provides overlay click behavior, close button with Icon, portal targeting, and JSS-styled overlay/modal/content layout. Uses document.querySelector for app element binding.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with react-modal integration, JSS injectCSS styling

nodes.name: Modal/styles.ts
nodes.summary: JSS style definitions for Modal component. Defines overlay (fixed fullscreen), modal container (centered with shadow and border radius), content padding, and close button positioning. Uses theme variables for overlay and modal background colors.
nodes.languageNotes: JSS style function receiving theme, CSS-in-JS

nodes.name: Radio.tsx
nodes.summary: Radio button form field component for mobx-react-form integration. Renders labeled radio options with error state display. Supports auto-focus via ref forwarding and selected state styling.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with @observer, mobx-react-form FieldInterface integration

nodes.name: SearchInput.tsx
nodes.summary: Search input component with debounced onChange, auto-focus, reset button with close icon, and magnify icon. Supports configurable throttle delay and controlled value state. Uses @mdi/js icons and lodash debounce.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with @observer, lodash debounce, @mdi/js icons

nodes.name: Select.tsx
nodes.summary: Select dropdown form field component for mobx-react-form integration. Supports single and multiple selection modes with JSON-encoded array parsing. Uses ref forwarding for multiple option extraction.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with @observer, mobx-react-form Field integration, JSON parsing for multi-select

nodes.name: ServiceIcon.tsx
nodes.summary: Service icon component that renders a service's custom icon with JSS-styled dimensions. Supports disabled (grayscale) and custom icon styling variants. Receives a Service model instance to display its icon.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with @observer, JSS withStyles, Service model prop

nodes.name: Slider.tsx
nodes.summary: Range slider form field component for mobx-react-form integration. Supports range and number types, default value fallback, disabled state, and custom onSliderChange callback. Uses CSS class franz-form conventions.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with @observer, supports number and range input types

nodes.name: StatusBarTargetUrl.tsx
nodes.summary: Status bar component that displays a target URL with fade-in animation via the Appear effect component. Used in the application chrome to show hovered link destinations.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with @observer, uses Appear animation wrapper

nodes.name: Tabs/TabItem.tsx
nodes.summary: Tab item placeholder component used within Tabs container. Provides a title prop used for rendering tab headers. Renders children wrapped in Fragment as the tab content.
nodes.languageNotes: Functional React component with typed IProps interface

nodes.name: Tabs/Tabs.tsx
nodes.summary: Tab container component managing tab switching state. Handles single-child passthrough and multi-tab rendering with active tab buttons and content panels. Uses React.Children utilities for child manipulation.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with @observer, uses Children.toArray and Children.map for child manipulation

nodes.name: WebviewLoader/index.tsx
nodes.summary: Webview loading overlay component that displays a FullscreenLoader with the service name during webview content loading. Uses theme-aware background and rounded container styling.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with react-intl i18n, JSS injectSheet, @observer

nodes.name: badge/ProBadge.tsx
nodes.summary: Pro badge component displaying a star icon within a primary-colored Badge wrapper. Supports inverted styling mode with swapped accent/contrast colors. Uses @mdi/js star icon and JSS theme for border radius.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component, JSS injectStyle with theme, @mdi/js star icon

nodes.name: badge/index.tsx
nodes.summary: Badge component dynamically generating styles for each theme styleType. Renders an inline-block badge with type-based coloring (primary, secondary, etc.). Used as a base by ProBadge for premium feature indicators.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component, JSS injectStyle with dynamic theme-driven style generation

nodes.name: button/index.tsx
nodes.summary: Versatile button component supporting six style types (primary, secondary, success, danger, warning, inverted). Features loading spinner state via busy prop, icon support via @mdi/react, optional href link rendering, and accessibility attributes. Handles prefers-reduced-motion for CSS transitions.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component (247 lines) with JSS withStyles, @mdi/react icons, getDerivedStateFromProps lifecycle

nodes.name: colorPickerInput/index.tsx
nodes.summary: Color picker form field component wrapping react-color's SliderPicker. Includes a text input for manual hex entry. Integrates with mobx-react-form via FormFields interface and supports ref forwarding.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with @observer, react-color SliderPicker integration, mobx-react-form FormFields

nodes.name: effects/Appear.tsx
nodes.summary: Animation wrapper component using react-transition-group CSSTransition. Provides configurable fade-in/out transitions with customizable timeout durations and class names. Used by InfoBar and StatusBarTargetUrl for entrance animations.
nodes.languageNotes: Functional React component wrapping react-transition-group CSSTransition

nodes.name: error/index.tsx
nodes.summary: Error message display component rendering styled error text using JSS. Used by Radio and other form fields to display validation errors with theme-aware danger color.
nodes.languageNotes: React class component with JSS injectSheet, theme-based styling

nodes.name: Form Field Components
nodes.summary: Collection of mobx-react-form-compatible UI components including Radio, Select, Slider, ColorPickerInput, SearchInput, and error display. All follow franz-form CSS class conventions and integrate with FieldInterface for state management.
nodes.languageNotes: Shared form field pattern with mobx-react-form Field type integration

nodes.name: Notification Display Components
nodes.summary: Set of notification/info display components: InfoBar (sliding notification bar with CTA), Infobox (dismissible infobox with icon), and StatusBarTargetUrl (target URL display). All use Appear animation for entrance effects.
nodes.languageNotes: Shared animation via Appear component, @mdi/js icons, react-intl i18n

nodes.name: Loading Indicator Components
nodes.summary: Heirarchy of loading components: FullscreenLoader (base fullscreen layout), AppLoader (startup with rotating slogans), WebviewLoader (per-service loading), Loader (spinner component), and button loading states. Provide consistent loading UX across app initialization and service webview loading.
nodes.languageNotes: Component hierarchy with composition pattern, JSS theming for colors

nodes.name: error/styles.ts
nodes.summary: JSS style function for the Error component. Exports a single function that takes theme and returns a message style object using theme.brandDanger for error text color.

nodes.name: H1, H2 (Headline Components)

nodes.name: HeadlineComponent

nodes.name: Icon
nodes.summary: SVG icon component used across auth forms for navigation arrows and status indicators.
nodes.languageNotes: Material Design Icons wrapper

nodes.name: IconComponent
nodes.summary: React class component wrapping MdiIcon. Accepts icon path string, size, and optional className. Warns on missing icon prop.

nodes.name: imageUpload/index.tsx
nodes.summary: Image upload component with drag-and-drop support via react-dropzone. Features image preview, delete action, file size validation, and error state display. Uses mobx observer pattern. Supports multiple files and max size limits.

nodes.name: ImageUpload
nodes.summary: MobX-observed React class component for image file uploads. Handles drop acceptance/rejection, file path normalization (Windows compat), preview rendering, and delete actions.

nodes.name: infobox/index.tsx
nodes.summary: Infobox notification component with dismiss functionality, CTA button, and icon support. Dynamically generates styles from theme.styleTypes for various notification types (primary, danger, etc.). Uses setTimeout for dismiss animation.

nodes.name: InfoboxComponent
nodes.summary: React class component for dismissible notification infoboxes. Supports icon, type-based theming, CTA buttons, and dismiss with delay animation.

nodes.name: Input
nodes.summary: Form input component with password toggle, focus management, showLabel option, and password strength scoring integration used across auth forms.
nodes.languageNotes: Styled input with password toggle and scoring

nodes.name: Input
nodes.summary: MobX-observed React class component for form input fields. Features password score meter, show/hide toggle, auto-focus, keyboard enter handling, and data attribute binding.

nodes.name: input/scorePassword.ts
nodes.summary: Password strength scoring utility. Scores passwords based on character uniqueness (5pts per unique char) and character variation (digits, lowercase, uppercase, non-word chars). Returns a score from 0-100.

nodes.name: scorePasswordFunc
nodes.summary: Pure function that calculates password strength. Awards points for unique characters (diminishing returns after 5 repetitions) and bonus points for character variety (uppercase, lowercase, digits, symbols).

nodes.name: input/styles.ts
nodes.summary: JSS style definitions for the Input component. Includes styles for input wrapper, disabled state, prefix/suffix adornments, password score meter with webkit vendor styling, error state, and placeholder styling.

nodes.name: label/index.tsx
nodes.summary: Form label component. Renders an HTML label element with optional title, required indicator (asterisk), and child content. Supports show/hide toggle for label text via showLabel prop.

nodes.name: LabelComponent
nodes.summary: React class component for form labels. Handles showLabel toggle, required asterisk, and wraps children inside label element.

nodes.name: label/styles.ts
nodes.summary: JSS style definitions for the Label component. Minimal styles for label text color and error state color via theme tokens.

nodes.name: loader/index.tsx
nodes.summary: Loading spinner component using react-loader-spinner (Oval). Injects mobx stores for accent color from settings. Supports custom size, color, and loaded state to hide spinner.

nodes.name: LoaderComponent
nodes.summary: React class component that renders an Oval loading spinner. Uses mobx-injected stores for accent color theme. Supports size, color, and visibility control via loaded prop.

nodes.name: select/index.tsx
nodes.summary: Comprehensive custom select/dropdown component with search/filter, keyboard navigation (arrow keys, enter), scroll-into-view for active option, and theming. Supports disabled options, error state, and data attributes. Largest component in the batch at 462 lines.

nodes.name: SelectComponent
nodes.summary: React class component implementing a full-featured select dropdown. Features include search filtering, arrow key navigation, scroll-to-active-option, toggle animation, and hidden input for form integration.

nodes.name: textarea/index.tsx
nodes.summary: Textarea form component with data attribute binding, error display, and label integration. Wraps textarea in Label and Wrapper components. Supports disabled, required, placeholder, and row count props.

nodes.name: TextareaComponent
nodes.summary: React class component for form textarea inputs. Binds data attributes on mount, handles onChange forwarding, and integrates with Label/Wrapper/Error sub-components.

nodes.name: textarea/styles.ts
nodes.summary: JSS style definitions for the Textarea component. Mirrors input styles for visual consistency. Includes textarea base styles, wrapper layout, disabled opacity, error border, and form modifier button styles.

nodes.name: toggle/index.tsx
nodes.summary: Toggle switch component with animated button sliding. Renders a checkbox input styled as a toggle switch. Supports checked state, disabled, error display, and respects prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.name: Toggle
nodes.summary: React class component for toggle/switch inputs. Animated toggle button with checked state visual feedback, disabled opacity, and reduced-motion support.

nodes.name: typings/generic.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript type definitions for form UI components. Defines IFormField interface (showLabel, label, error, required, noMargin), Omit utility type, and Merge utility type. Used by Input, Select, Textarea, Toggle, Label, and Headline components.

nodes.name: UI Form Types
nodes.summary: Central type definitions module for the UI form component library. Provides IFormField as the base interface for all form components, plus Omit and Merge utility types.

nodes.name: wrapper/index.tsx
nodes.summary: Form field layout wrapper component. Provides consistent spacing and data-type identifier for form fields. Accepts noMargin prop to remove bottom margin. Used by Input, Select, Textarea, Toggle, and other form components.

nodes.name: WrapperComponent
nodes.summary: React class component that wraps form fields in a container div with consistent styling and a data-type identifier for testing/automation.

nodes.name: main.scss
nodes.summary: Central style entry point that imports all other SCSS partials and the electron-react-titlebar library. Acts as the compilation root for the application's stylesheet.
nodes.languageNotes: SCSS entry point; uses @import for all partials; imports from node_modules and local partials

nodes.name: globals.scss
nodes.summary: Defines all raw SCSS variables for the design token system including brand colors, gray palette, dark theme colors, border radii, sidebar width, and text colors. Values are stored as RGB strings for runtime themability.
nodes.languageNotes: SCSS variables with raw RGB string values (e.g. '114,102,240') for dynamic theme injection

nodes.name: colors.scss
nodes.summary: Converts raw RGB string variables from globals.scss into real SCSS color values using convert-rgb-string-to-color and to-number helper functions. Produces the final color, sizing, and spacing token set used by all other stylesheets.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses SCSS functions for runtime string-to-color conversion; imports type-helper.scss for convert-rgb-string-to-color and to-number

nodes.name: config.scss
nodes.summary: Style configuration hub that imports colors.scss and defines split-columns layout variables. Imported by most component SCSS files as their single dependency for all design tokens.
nodes.languageNotes: SCSS partial; acts as barrel export for color tokens

nodes.name: mixins.scss
nodes.summary: Contains reusable SCSS mixins used across form components. Defines the formLabel mixin for consistent form label styling.
nodes.languageNotes: SCSS mixin definition with @mixin directive

nodes.name: reset.scss
nodes.summary: CSS reset based on Meyerweb reset pattern. Normalizes all HTML elements, sets box-sizing to border-box, configures base typography (Open Sans, 62.5% base size), and applies dark theme body color.
nodes.languageNotes: SCSS with Meyer reset pattern; uses config variables for theme colors

nodes.name: fonts.scss
nodes.summary: Declares Open Sans @font-face rules for all required weights: Light (300), Regular, Bold, BoldItalic, ExtraBold (800), and ExtraBoldItalic. Font files sourced from src/assets/fonts/.
nodes.languageNotes: SCSS with @font-face declarations referencing local .ttf files

nodes.name: layout.scss

nodes.languageNotes: SCSS with CSS animations (@keyframes), CSS custom properties (--workspace-drawer-width), and dark theme overrides

nodes.name: animations.scss

nodes.languageNotes: SCSS with React transition group class naming pattern (-appear, -enter, -leave)

nodes.name: auth.scss

nodes.name: badge.scss

nodes.languageNotes: SCSS with BEM modifier classes (badge--primary, badge--success)

nodes.name: button.scss

nodes.name: capture-sources.scss

nodes.name: ServicesStore
nodes.summary: The primary store managing all service instances and their lifecycle. nodes.name: SettingsStore

nodes.name: UIStore

nodes.name: UserStore

layers.name: Application Core Layer
layers.description: Top-level application entry points and configuration files at the src/ root: Electron main process entry (index.ts), React renderer entry (app.tsx), router configuration (routes.tsx), environment configs (config.ts, environment.ts, environment-remote.ts), i18n setup (I18n.tsx), shared utilities (jsUtils.ts, prop-types.ts, electron-util.ts), error reporting (sentry.ts), preload scripts (preload-safe-debug.ts), and platform-specific files (index.html, enforce-macos-app-location.ts).

layers.name: Electron Main Process Layer
layers.description: Electron main process modules (src/electron/) for window management, settings persistence, deep linking, error handling, and macOS permissions, plus system integration libraries (src/lib/) for DBus (Linux), Menu, TouchBar (macOS), Tray, and Form handling.

layers.name: Features Layer
layers.description: Self-contained feature modules (src/features/) each with their own store, actions, components, and containers: workspaces (service grouping), todos (built-in todo panel), basicAuth (HTTP basic auth), publishDebugInfo, quickSwitch (Cmd+K switcher), communityRecipes (recipe browser), utils (FeatureStore framework), webControls (navigation controls), appearance (theme/accent management), and serviceProxy (per-service proxy).

layers.name: WebView Layer
layers.description: Service WebView integration scripts (src/webview/) that inject into each service's webview context for badge/unread count extraction, dark mode injection, context menu building, dialog title detection, find-in-page, notification handling, spell checking, screen sharing, session management, and zoom control.

layers.name: Internal Server Layer
layers.description: Embedded AdonisJS 5 server (src/internal-server/) providing offline/local-first API capabilities with SQLite database, including: Ace CLI entry point, server startup/config, route definitions, kernel middleware, database migrations (user, service, recipe, workspace schemas), AdonisJS config files (app, auth, bodyParser, cors, database, drive, hash, session, shield), Edge template views (import, index, transfer), and public CSS/JS assets.

layers.name: Presentation Assets Layer
layers.description: Styling and presentation resources: SCSS stylesheets (src/styles/) for all UI components, layouts, animations, typography, and service views; theme definitions (src/themes/) supporting dark, default, and legacy color schemes; and internationalization (src/i18n/) with 30+ locale JSON translation files plus language registry and translation utility modules.

layers.name: Infrastructure & Configuration Layer
layers.description: Build toolchain, CI/CD, project docs, development tooling, and root configuration: Docker setup (Dockerfile, .dockerignore), GitHub CI/issue templates, Electron packaging (electron-builder.yml), esbuild bundler config, Jest test configuration, commitlint/husky git hooks, ESLint/Biome formatting, Crowdin translation management, migration scripts, Linux DBus integration docs, and project governance docs (README, CONTRIBUTING, CHANGELOG, LICENSE, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, SECURITY).

tour.title: Project Overview — What Is Ferdium?
tour.description: Start here to understand the project at a glance. README.md introduces Ferdium as a hard-fork of Franz that aggregates messaging services (Slack, WhatsApp, Gmail, etc.) into a single Electron desktop window. It covers download links, migration from Ferdi, styling customization, and contribution guidelines — essential context before touching any code.
tour.languageLesson: The project uses Electron + React + MobX + TypeScript with an embedded AdonisJS internal server. Install deps via pnpm, build with esbuild, package with electron-builder.

tour.title: Electron Main Process — Application Bootstrap
tour.description: src/index.ts is the Electron main process entry point, responsible for app lifecycle, window creation, and IPC setup. It bootstraps the entire application — importing config, environment settings, window utilities, deep linking, exception handling, system tray, and feature modules. src/app.tsx runs in the renderer process to mount the React application tree.
tour.languageLesson: config.ts has the highest fan-in in the graph (68 incoming edges), making it the most-referenced module. It provides a centralized configuration object consumed across the entire codebase.

tour.title: Routing & Application Core — React Router Setup
tour.description: src/routes.tsx defines all application routes via the FerdiumRoutes class (fan-out 30), mapping URL paths to screen components for auth flows (login, signup, setup), settings (services, account, user), and the main app layout. Environment detection (src/environment.ts) toggles between development, staging, and production builds. The preload-safe-debug.ts script bridges Electron's preload context to the renderer.

tour.title: State Management — MobX Stores
tour.description: Ferdium uses MobX for reactive state management. All stores are registered via the barrel file src/stores/index.ts. Each store manages a distinct domain: AppStore (global app state, focus, timers), ServicesStore (service lifecycle and unread counts), SettingsStore (persisted app settings), UIStore (sidebar visibility, theme toggling), and more. Stores receive references to each other, the API layer, and actions via a central initialization pattern.

tour.title: API Layer — Dual-Backend Communication
tour.description: src/api/index.ts creates the unified API interface backed by two implementations: ServerApi for remote Ferdium server communication and LocalApi for the embedded local server. Shared base classes (apiBase.ts) handle HTTP requests, error handling, and auth token management. Individual API modules (AppApi, ServicesApi, RecipesApi, UserApi, FeaturesApi) each encapsulate a domain's endpoints.
tour.languageLesson: The dual-backend pattern (remote + local) allows Ferdium to work both with the Ferdium cloud service and fully offline via its embedded AdonisJS server, which is a key architectural differentiator from Franz.

tour.title: Electron Main Process — System Integration & IPC
tour.description: The src/electron/ directory houses main-process utilities: Settings (persistent config via electron-store), deepLinking (custom protocol handler), windowUtils (window positioning/sizing), and exception handling. The src/lib/ directory provides OS-level integrations: Menu (custom app menu), Tray (system tray icon with context menu), DBus (Linux desktop notifications), and TouchBar (macOS). Ten IPC handlers in src/electron/ipc-api bridge renderer requests to main-process capabilities like auto-updates, downloads, and DND.
tour.languageLesson: IPC handlers use a consistent pattern: ipcMain.handle('event-name', handler) in the main process, exposed to the renderer via contextBridge in preload scripts.

tour.title: WebView Integration — Service Rendering Engine
tour.description: Each messaging service (Slack, WhatsApp, etc.) runs inside an isolated Electron WebView. The src/webview/ layer injects behavior into these WebViews: recipe.ts (the core orchestrator, fan-out 34), badge.ts (unread count extraction from page title/DOM), darkmode.ts (CSS injection for dark mode), notifications.ts (capturing service notifications), contextMenu.ts (custom right-click menus), find.ts (find-in-page), screenshare.ts, spellchecker.ts, and zoom.ts. RecipeWebview is the base class managing WebView lifecycle.

tour.title: Internal Server — Embedded AdonisJS Backend
tour.description: Ferdium ships an embedded AdonisJS 5 server (src/internal-server/) with SQLite for offline/local-first operation. The server handles user auth, service/recipe/workspace CRUD, and data migration. Key files: start.ts (server bootstrap), routes.js (API route definitions), internal-server-config (meta-module aggregating all AdonisJS configs: app, auth, CORS, database, session, shield), and SQLite migration files defining the database schema.

tour.title: Feature Modules — Self-Contained Plugins
tour.description: Each feature in src/features/ is a self-contained module with its own store, components, and initialization: workspaces (service grouping with a drag-and-drop drawer), todos (built-in todo panel with its own WebView), basicAuth (HTTP basic auth prompts in WebViews), quickSwitch (Cmd/Ctrl+K service switcher overlay), appearance (theme/accent color dynamic CSS generation, fan-out 26), and serviceProxy (per-service proxy configuration). Features use a shared FeatureStore base class and ActionBinding utility.

tour.title: UI Components — React Screens & Layouts
tour.description: The src/components/ and src/containers/ directories house all React UI — auth screens (Login, Signup, SetupAssistant, Welcome, Locked), settings dashboards (ServicesDashboard, AccountDashboard, RecipesDashboard, TeamDashboard), service views (Services, ServiceView, ServiceWebview, ConnectionLostBanner), and layout wrappers (SettingsLayout, AuthLayout, Tabbar). Components use MobX injection for state access and Material-UI for theming.

tour.title: Styling & Theming — SCSS & Theme System
tour.description: Styling is a mix of SCSS (src/styles/) and MUI theming (src/themes/). The main.scss entry (fan-out 21) imports modular stylesheets for layout, animations, typography, forms, and service-specific chrome. The theme system supports dark, default, and legacy color schemes, each defined as TypeScript objects with color tokens. A 'styles-system' concept node emerges from the graph analysis as a cross-cutting concern referenced by 25+ nodes, highlighting the tight coupling between theming and component code.

tour.title: Infrastructure & Dev Tooling — Build & Deploy
tour.description: The project build pipeline: esbuild.mjs (fast bundler for TS/TSX/SCSS), electron-builder.yml (cross-platform packaging for macOS/Windows/Linux), Dockerfile (containerized builds), and GitHub CI/CD workflows (builds.yml) that run linting, testing, code signing, notarization, and release publishing across all platforms. For new contributors, CONTRIBUTING.md documents the setup process including pnpm install, dev server, and pre-commit hooks.
tour.languageLesson: The build chain: esbuild dev server on :8080 → Electron loads from dev server → production build bundles with esbuild → electron-builder packages platform-specific installers. Pre-commit hook runs typecheck + lint + prettier + translations check.
